title: TRICARE Retired Reserve Recall Paid-Month Credit: Counting From the Active Duty Effective Date
content:
**Training questions - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Retired Reserve.**

**Rule.** The day the recall paid-month credit is counted from follows the purchaser's TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member enrollment: where that enrollment is applied or active and its effective date falls inside the most recently paid month, the recall paid-month credit is counted from that effective date; where that enrollment is applied or active and its effective date falls before the most recently paid month began, the recall paid-month credit is counted from the first day of the month; otherwise the recall paid-month credit is counted from the plan's termination date.

**Which enrollment is read?** The recalled purchaser's own TRICARE Prime enrollment in the Active Duty Service Member tier - its status and its effective date.

**Which month is "the most recently paid month"?** The coverage month of the bill settled by the latest posted premium payment on the TRICARE Retired Reserve plan.

**The enrollment is active and its effective date is 12 May, the most recently paid month being May.** The credit is counted from 12 May.

**The enrollment is applied with an effective date of 28 April, the most recently paid month being May.** The effective date falls before May began, so the credit is counted from 1 May.

**The enrollment's status is neither applied nor active, or there is none, or its effective date is in June.** None of the first two cases holds, so the credit is counted from the plan's termination date.
